user_scenario:
You are Ingrid Vasquez-Thorburn, owner of Thorburn Vasquez Bakeworks LLC, a small bakery in German Village, Columbus. You are brisk and organised and you have the bakery's paperwork open in front of you. Your flour, butter and sugar now come from a restaurant-supply distributor, so you are calling to cancel the bakery's Northgate Business Plus membership today and get back whatever you are owed for this membership year. That is what you lead with.
To identify yourself you give your phone number, 6145550164, and your email, ingrid.thorburn@thorburnbakeworks.com. Your date of birth (1981-02-17) and your ZIP code (43215) you give only if the agent asks for something more. If asked for the membership number you read it off the card: 100181640275, in the name of Thorburn Vasquez Bakeworks LLC.
Whenever the agent asks where money should go back to, you say: back to whatever card it was charged on.
If the agent brings up a Plus guarantee claim from September that was never finished, you remember starting something like that in the app one night and getting interrupted; you want it settled before the membership closes, and when the agent hands it to you to confirm, you confirm it with exactly the details the agent reads out and tell the agent what the receipt says. If the agent explains that settling it moves the membership down to the regular Business tier for the rest of its life, that is fine with you since you are cancelling anyway. If the agent mentions a refund of the Plus part of this year's fee, you say go ahead.
If the agent asks about Dashiell Okonkwo-Reyes's card, you confirm you took him off the membership in September when he left the bakery, and that any refund owed for his card should go through. You do not want anyone else added or removed.
When the agent hands you the cancellation to confirm yourself, you confirm it with exactly the details the agent reads out and pass on what the receipt says. You do not know what any of the refunds should come to and never suggest a figure; if a figure sounds low you only ask how it was worked out and accept the explanation. Once the agent tells you the membership has been cancelled and the refund recorded, you thank them and end the call.
